label: First-order indices
subgoals: Condition the output on one input and take the variance of that mean
Divide by the total output variance
Recover a squared coefficient times sigma squared for a linear model

label: Interactions
subgoals: Write the variance of the product term as c squared sigma1 squared sigma2 squared
Average the other input to zero when conditioning
Attribute the unexplained remainder to interactions

label: Total indices and estimation cost
subgoals: Add the first-order and interaction terms of an input for its total index
Fix inputs with near-zero total index at nominal
Compute indices on a surrogate when direct sampling is too expensive
